description: Variants and full text of one query mask. Open it from the Statements board. Source: ClickHouse pg_monitoring (dual write).

panels.description: Full mask text (pg_stmt_text, collected every 10 min, latest text regardless of the time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT env, query_mask_md5, c_query_mask AS query_mask FROM (SELECT env, query_mask_md5, argMax(query_mask, time) AS c_query_mask FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_text WHERE $__conditionalAll(env IN (${env:singlequote}), $env) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY env, query_mask_md5)

panels.title: Query mask

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, env, db_instance, usename, sum(greatest(c_calls - p_calls, 0) / dateDiff('second', pt, t)) AS calls FROM (SELECT t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, lagInFrame(t, 1, t) OVER w AS pt, c_calls, lagInFrame(c_calls, 1, c_calls) OVER w AS p_calls FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, argMax(calls, time) AS c_calls FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_mask WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(env IN (${env:singlequote}), $env) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5 ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE t > pt GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, usename ORDER BY t

panels.description: Execution time / calls per interval: a step up with steady calls means a plan / data regression.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, env, db_instance, usename, sum(greatest(c_total_ms - p_total_ms, 0)) / nullIf(sum(greatest(c_calls - p_calls, 0)), 0) AS mean_ms FROM (SELECT t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, lagInFrame(t, 1, t) OVER w AS pt, c_total_ms, lagInFrame(c_total_ms, 1, c_total_ms) OVER w AS p_total_ms, c_calls, lagInFrame(c_calls, 1, c_calls) OVER w AS p_calls FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, argMax(total_exec_time, time) AS c_total_ms, argMax(calls, time) AS c_calls FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_mask WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(env IN (${env:singlequote}), $env) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5 ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE t > pt GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, usename ORDER BY t

panels.title: Mean time per call

panels.description: Rows returned / affected per call: growth means the result set (data or filter) changes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, env, db_instance, usename, sum(greatest(c_rows - p_rows, 0)) / nullIf(sum(greatest(c_calls - p_calls, 0)), 0) AS rows FROM (SELECT t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, lagInFrame(t, 1, t) OVER w AS pt, c_rows, lagInFrame(c_rows, 1, c_rows) OVER w AS p_rows, c_calls, lagInFrame(c_calls, 1, c_calls) OVER w AS p_calls FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, argMax(rows, time) AS c_rows, argMax(calls, time) AS c_calls FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_mask WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(env IN (${env:singlequote}), $env) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5 ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE t > pt GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, usename ORDER BY t

panels.title: Rows per call

panels.description: Buffer hits / reads per call (8 KB blocks): growth with steady rows per call means more pages scanned for the same result (plan change, bloat).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, env, db_instance, usename, sum(greatest(c_hit - p_hit, 0)) / nullIf(sum(greatest(c_calls - p_calls, 0)), 0) AS blks_hit, sum(greatest(c_read - p_read, 0)) / nullIf(sum(greatest(c_calls - p_calls, 0)), 0) AS blks_read FROM (SELECT t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, lagInFrame(t, 1, t) OVER w AS pt, c_hit, lagInFrame(c_hit, 1, c_hit) OVER w AS p_hit, c_read, lagInFrame(c_read, 1, c_read) OVER w AS p_read, c_calls, lagInFrame(c_calls, 1, c_calls) OVER w AS p_calls FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, argMax(shared_blks_hit, time) AS c_hit, argMax(shared_blks_read, time) AS c_read, argMax(calls, time) AS c_calls FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_mask WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(env IN (${env:singlequote}), $env) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND match(query_mask_md5, concat('^(', ${query_mask_md5:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5 ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) WHERE t > pt GROUP BY t, env, db_instance, usename ORDER BY t

AS blks_hit, c_temp_blks_written AS temp_blks_written, c_query AS query, total_ms / nullIf(calls, 0) AS mean_ms FROM (SELECT env, db_instance, datname, usename, query_mask_md5, query_md5, queryid, options.content:
# Slow query regression

**Symptom.** Response time of an endpoint grows; DB CPU / IO grows without a matching increase in traffic.

**Where to look.** `pg-statements` → *Top masks* table (sorted by total time over the range) →
click `query_mask_md5` → `pg-statement-detail` (variants by `query_md5`, full text, calls / time series).

**How to interpret.**
- Over the range: `spread(total_exec_time)` = time spent, `spread(calls)` = executions,
  mean = `spread(total_exec_time) / spread(calls)` (ms).
- Compare the same mask for two ranges (before / after release): mean ↑ with calls ≈ → plan / data regression;
  calls ↑ with mean ≈ → more traffic or an N+1 pattern.
- `variants` of a mask ≫ 1 → the same statement shape is produced with different IN-list sizes etc.
- `shared_blks_read` ↑ → data no longer fits the cache ([cache hit drop](cache-hit-drop.md));
  `temp_blks_written` ↑ → sorts / hashes spill ([temp file spills](temp-file-spills.md)).
- `rows / calls` ↑ → the query returns more data (missing filter / pagination).

**Likely causes.** New code path, changed plan (stale statistics, parameter sniffing on generic plans),
missing index, data growth, N+1 queries from the ORM.

**Actions.**
1. Take the full text from `pg_stmt_text` (detail board) and run `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` on a copy.
2. Check [autovacuum / analyze](autovacuum-lag.md) freshness of the involved tables.
3. Check [indexes](unused-missing-indexes.md) for seq-scan-heavy tables involved.
4. For N+1: batch the calls (`= ANY($1)`), which also collapses variants.

**Related SQL.** `sql/cluster_stmt_mask.sql`, `sql/cluster_stmt.sql`, `sql/cluster_stmt_text.sql`.
